opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be aged 18 and over; be a UK or Republic of Ireland resident (with UK/ROI address and bank account) or apply on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK or ROI; have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Supports members, individuals and organisations to run chemistry-based engagement activities connecting communities with the chemical sciences, with rolling deadlines throughout 2026 and a final deadline of 2 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Research Fund

amount.raw: The scheme provides up to £5000 of funding for 12 months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) holding an independent research post; not currently holding another active Research Fund grant; one application per department with Head of Department support.
opportunities.summary: Supports members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early career researchers. Round 1 is closed; Round 2 applications open 12 October 2026 and close 30 November 2026.

opportunities.title: Researcher Development and Travel Grant

amount.raw: You can apply for a grant of up to £500

opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Partner Scientist, Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) who are PhD students in chemical sciences or researchers within 10 years of leaving full-time education.
opportunities.summary: Supports PhD students and early career scientists to undertake an activity that supports their research career, such as conference participation, training courses, or organising scientific meetings. Round 3 is closed; Round 4 applications open 14 September 2026 and close 19 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Researcher Collaborations Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC); PhD students or researchers at any career stage working in any sector or location.
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers to establish and develop national, international, interdisciplinary and cross-sector collaborations and networks, including research visits and organising meetings/workshops. Applications are currently open and close 21 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Grants for Carers
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be a chemist; based in the UK or Ireland (or hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years if based outside); incurring additional caring expenses while attending a chemistry-related meeting/conference/workshop or professional development event.
opportunities.summary: Supports carers with up to £1,200 per year to cover additional caring costs incurred while attending a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event. Rolling application with no stated deadline.

opportunities.title: Accessibility Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be a chemist; based in the UK or Ireland (or hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years if based outside); requiring support or assistance related to a disability, impairment or health condition to attend a chemistry-related event.
opportunities.summary: Supports disabled chemists and those with health conditions with up to £1,200 per year to cover the cost of accessibility support needed to attend chemistry-related meetings, conferences, workshops or professional development events. Rolling application with no stated deadline.
